meta.title: MepMail for Linux: Correio on the desktop (.deb, .rpm, AppImage)
meta.description: Download the MepMail app for Linux: Correio in its own window, with a tray icon, unread count, mepmail:// links and a bridge for AI agents.

linux.title: MepMail on <highlight>Linux</highlight>
linux.lead: Correio in its own window, with a tray icon, unread count, mepmail:// links and the bridge for your AI agents. Pick the package for your distribution.
linux.commandLabel: In a terminal, in the download folder

deb.name: .deb package
deb.body: Installs through the package manager and shows up in the app menu.
deb.updates: the app tells you about a new version and installs it from the tray, with your system password.

rpm.name: .rpm package
rpm.body: Installs through the package manager and shows up in the app menu.
rpm.updates: the app tells you about a new version and installs it from the tray, with your system password.

appimage.name: AppImage
appimage.body: One file, nothing to install. It carries its own WebKitGTK, so it is bigger (about 80 MB).
appimage.updates: the file updates itself, no password needed.

tips: The tray icon uses AppIndicator. On GNOME without the AppIndicator extension (Ubuntu ships it), the app works the same, just without the icon.
Agent keys live in the system keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet), never in a text file.
Start with the system and Keep in tray on close are in the tray icon's menu.
linux.windows: On Windows, the app is in the Microsoft Store.
linux.source: The app's source code on GitHub
